issues.reason: (Most <scale> X <class>) has no restrictor slot and no licensed encoding exists for a PP on the comparison class (the reviewer's own q2 gap), so this mistakes a coverage gap for a defect — and 'in the world' over the class 'thing' restricts nothing, so its omission drops no real claim.
'A woman is a thing' admits no conceivable counterexample, so the confidence dial's definitional/taxonomic branch mandates 0.99, not the empirical 0.9.

gaps_confirmed: superlative with a stated domain restrictor ('the ADJ-est N in/of D') — Most has no slot for the domain PP
superlative predicated of a generic kind subject — Most and its companion class atom are specified only for individuals (Member), so the kind case needs the Inheritance adaptation
repair_summary: Raised woman_thing's confidence from 0.9 to 0.99 (taxonomic link); nothing else changed.
notes: The Most-over-kind adaptation (Inheritance in place of Member for the class link) is the faithful generic-kind analog and asserts nothing false.
